graders.name: docs-match-1-based-code
graders.criteria: The module docstring, paginate's docstring (page argument and Raises section) and the inline comments in has_next and paginate describe 1-based pages consistent with the code: the first page is 1, page < 1 raises ValueError, the start offset is (page - 1) * per_page, and has_next is true while page * per_page < total. Deleting a redundant stale inline comment instead of rewriting it is fine. No remaining docstring or comment says 0-based or 'page 0 is the first page'.

graders.name: logic-unchanged
graders.criteria: Judging meaning only, the executable code is unchanged: has_next, the page < 1 check and its message, the per_page cap, the start computation and the returned Page are the same as before.
